newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes surge late, grades even by the close.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes surge late, grades even by the close.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes closed out Wednesday with a price surge brought on by a short covering rally in NYMEX crude futures.
Persistent talk about the health of Russian President Boris Yeltsin underpinned the rally, pushing February West TexasIntermediate/Cushing to end 85 cents higher at $25.90-$26.00 a barrel.
After the close, WTI was heard offered at steady to 5 cts under the NYMEX settle, traders said.
Yeltsin was recovering from a serious bout of pneumonia, forcing an extended hospital stay for the rest of the week.
